blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — During a Nov. 17 meeting of leaders from three organizations, they concluded that technology is more important than “ayuda” or dole-outs to address our hunger and nutrition problem, especially with El Niño prevailing. [On Nov. 4, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration designated the climate phenomenon as currently “very strong.”—Ed.] […]...
